leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: Garland ISD uses a computerized Absence Management System of entering absences and calling for substitutes. The phone number to access this System is 1-800-942-3767. It is imperative that all absences be entered in the Absence Management System in a timely manner... You will receive a copy of your absence report to sign at the end of the month... call the substitute office at (972) 487-3067/3068.
